caption: The image is a drawing featuring a single round table centrally positioned on a plain, light beige background. The table has a white or light gray marble top with a slightly beveled edge and a wooden structure beneath. The wooden base is brown, composed of four curved and ornate legs connected by a central spindle with decorative turnings. Each leg ends in a small caster wheel that appears metallic, possibly silver. The table's legs are connected by additional curved wooden supports, forming a symmetrical and ornate structure beneath the tabletop. The artist's signature "Jane Bartlett" appears in the lower right corner of the image. There are no other objects, decorations, or background elements present in the drawing.
title: Center Table, with Marble Top
